rules: DD HEADWEAR: no cap/hood/bandana/mask on head; hood = back-cowl only (cape-like); bare head + teal-blue glowing hair always visible; any head/face covering = REJECT

LEGENDARY WEAPONS MUST APPEAR: DD = twin Frostbite-class hand crossbows (ice-blue arcane crystal limbs, frost runes, frozen-light string, teal-blue glow); AZ = Dawnbreaker-class greatsword (pale sunsteel, molten-gold runes, golden holy fire edge, sunburst crossguard); hero sheet/keyframe without weapon = INCOMPLETE
WEAPON ANTI-SLOP: fantasy construction only; crossbow must NEVER read as firearm (no barrel/magazine/stock/Uzi/SMG silhouette = REJECT); anti-slop negatives always appended
BOSS FACE: Mal'garot HAS a prolific molten-lava face (lava dripping/running, drops falling to ground); faceless boss sheets SUPERSEDED
LOCATION BRIGHTNESS FLOOR: environment plates silhouette-readable at thumbnail; no murk-dark grades
